_comment: Emulators tools/Update-Emulators.ps1 checks (System Health line 'emulators', Tools > Emulator Updates). folder: regex on the folder name under <RetroFE>\emulators. version: how the installed version is read (am-version.txt written by our updates wins). latest: where the newest official release is published. action: update = download, verify, keep the listed settings / saves, back up every replaced file, copy in; report = shown only, with the reason; own-updater = the emulator's own updater does it; final = no newer release exists. keep: paths relative to the emulator folder (a folder keeps everything under it) never overwritten.

emulators.name: Supermodel (Model 3)
emulators.note: Config\Supermodel.ini (our wheel bindings) and saves are kept. The FFB plugin and its SDL2.dll stay as they are.

emulators.name: Dolphin (GameCube / Wii)
emulators.note: The User folder (controllers, Wii Remote and wheel settings, saves) is kept.

emulators.name: Cemu (Wii U)
emulators.warn: Big jump: Cemu 2 no longer loads cemuhook. Games, saves and controller profiles are kept, but try Mario Kart 8 afterwards; the backup folder puts 1.x back.
emulators.note: Games and saves (mlc01), controller profiles and settings are kept.

emulators.name: MAME
emulators.note: Shown only: a new MAME needs ROM sets made for that version, so MAME and its ROMs are updated together, by hand.

emulators.name: TeknoParrot

latest.none: TeknoParrot updates itself: its own updater checks each part (TeknoParrot, OpenParrot, SegaTools ...).

emulators.note: Opens TeknoParrot so its own updater can run; our wheel bindings live in UserProfiles, which it keeps.
